rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and ZIP, matching a single user account before accessing or changing any data. It retrieved both orders with read-only tools, correctly noted both were pending, and did not invent reasons beyond tool evidence. For the cancellation of #W2702727, the agent requested explicit confirmation and a reason before performing the write, then executed the cancellation via tool and provided a refund total ($625.60) consistent with the item prices shown. For #W8268610, the agent stated the exact address change, obtained explicit confirmation, then updated the address using the appropriate tool and confirmed the result. All actions were performed on the authenticated user’s orders. No writes occurred without prior confirmation, no unsupported claims about order details were made, and the final information given was accurate per tool data. Minor note: the agent did not confirm the total price of #W8268610 after the address change, but the user did not request it in the conversation, so this does not violate the pass criteria.
